summary: Retest of the iteration-10 fixes only. All 4 fix groups PASS. Backend: test_platform_areas.py 16/16 and new test_iter11_fixes.py 15/15. Frontend (375x667 web preview): history back from lot form, Incassi and Analisi; Scegli quote -> 'Scelto'; tracciamento 'Aggiorna stato' shown only to the selected carrier (others see the waiting text), and a tracking update works; consumer /buyer/trattative redirects to /buyer/mercato; requisiti-mercato Back returns to /producer/export; pending banner shows for unapproved business and stays hidden for approved; '1 risposta' singular. No regressions in the retested areas.

minor.issue: Quotes are still accepted after a carrier is chosen (status 'assigned'). The same company can also quote several times. Suggest returning 422 when carrier_id is set and de-duplicating per company_id.

Check-then-set is not atomic, so two parallel selects could both succeed. Use update_one({_id, carrier_id: {$exists: false}}) and check modified_count. A non-creator gets 404 instead of 403. That is acceptable, just noted.

action_items: Optional: block new quotes on shipments that already have a carrier_id (422), and de-duplicate quotes per company.
Optional: make select-quote atomic (conditional update on carrier_id absent).
critical_code_review_comments: AreaTabs backBehavior='history' is correct and verified.
add_tracking correctly filters on carrier_id == current uid (403 otherwise). is_carrier is computed correctly.
admin/users uses re.escape. Searches for '(', '[', '*' and '.*' return 200 and are treated literally.
The RFQ free-plan limit counts only open RFQs, so a business on the free plan can close one and open another. That matches the stated design.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ shipments, RFQs and users were created for the run and then deleted: a TEST_ logistics user, a TEST_ unapproved producer, test_ui_pending_biz@example.com, the TEST_UI ship and the TEST_UI RFQ. business@demo.it is back on the free plan and no user is suspended. Older leftovers from earlier iterations are still in the DB and were not touched: 3 'TEST ...' shipments and several test_*@ users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 1, because pytest.ini adds xdist args. Export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL first. To create a selectable shipment for UI tests, run 'python3 tests/iter11_ui_seed.py' (prints shipment_id quote_id). Run 'python3 tests/iter11_ui_seed.py clean' afterwards. The back-button testID is header-back-button.
